items.title: Small acts, whole worlds
items.summary: So much of what makes a life bearable passes between us almost unnoticed. Someone pours the tea. Someone stays beside the bed. A few notes sound in an afternoon room, and something we had almost stopped listening for becomes audible again.
items.alt: A close view of hands offering a warm cup over bread at a worn wooden table.

images.title: Something warm
images.alt: A woman offers a cup to St Clement at a sunlit table, with a child nearby.
images.description: St Clement at the table, receiving a cup. The bread is broken, the child is busy, the afternoon has found its way through the leaves. There is room for holiness in a life like this.

images.title: Staying
images.alt: A seated woman holds the hand of an older person resting beneath a blue quilt.
images.description: After Yi Yi (2000). There are hours when love has very little power over what happens next. Still, there is a hand to hold, and someone to whom it matters that we stay.

images.title: What remains
images.alt: An older woman sews beside a bright window in a quiet room.

images.title: The door is open
images.alt: A child plays on a tiled floor beside an open doorway leading into sunlight.
images.description: From some of my earliest memories in Пробиштип, with my grandmother.

images.title: Less
images.alt: A person plays an upright piano in a spare room filled with soft afternoon light.
images.description: A tribute to Arvo Pärt, Nils Frahm, Max Richter, Ólafur Arnalds, and the music that makes room. A note sounds; the room receives it. As it fades, the silence has changed, and we find ourselves listening further into it.

images.title: For now
images.alt: A fallen apple rests among autumn leaves on a sunlit woodland path.
images.description: An apple returning, slowly, to the earth that made it. Even this gold will go. A small autumn contemplation, prompted by Ken McLeod’s reflections on impermanence.

images.title: A small bow
images.alt: A small child in red kneels beside flowers, incense and a gold-lit household shrine.
images.description: The whole body learning a gesture of gratitude. May whatever goodness begins here travel farther than we can see.

images.title: After lunch
images.alt: An older woman, a child and a man sit around a broad wooden table after lunch, with leafy light coming through an open window.
images.description: The plates can wait. Each person has drifted a little into their own afternoon, held in the easy company of the others.

images.title: The room remembers
images.alt: An older woman sits in a blue chair as figures and memories overlap in an interior of ochre, blue and red.
images.description: Someone is leaving through the doorway. Someone is still a child at the table. The afternoon falls across them all, as though the room has never quite learned which year it is.

images.title: The moth
images.alt: A woman crouches beside a tiny moth on a green curtain in an empty rehearsal hall; a large sun prop rests against the far wall.
images.description: The painted sun has been put away. Beside the curtain, a smaller life receives someone’s whole attention.

items.role: Created and curated by Petre Laskov in collaboration with AI.
items.description: Before the cup reaches the table, it has already said something: I thought of you. Here, have this while it’s warm.

items.title: There is no enemy
items.summary: Give up the battle. There is no enemy here.
items.alt: A robed figure sits with a dark-winged companion on steps overlooking a quiet landscape.

images.title: No need to hide
images.alt: A white-robed figure offers a hand to a seated dark-winged figure on stone steps.
images.description: Bring the part that sneers, the part that despairs, the part already preparing its refusal. The hand remains open. You can reach for it with all of that still here.

images.title: Nothing to win
images.alt: A dark-winged figure sitting beside a robed figure who extends an open hand.
images.description: Christ has sat down beside him. There is time for the clenched hand, the averted face, the long habit of expecting a fight. The afternoon goes on around them. No one is keeping score.

images.title: Close enough
images.alt: An icon-like painting of two adults and a child resting close together against gold.
images.description: A head comes to rest against another. The child leans into the warmth between them. Here, the distance we put between the human and the divine becomes difficult to find.

images.title: Held
images.alt: An icon-like family embrace, with a child nestled between two haloed adults.
images.description: The living God, holding and held. The child’s whole weight rests in the embrace. Need, tenderness, the wish to be close: let these belong to holiness too.

images.title: Room at the table
images.alt: People share supper at a long outdoor table beside a church overlooking Ohrid at dusk.
images.description: Communion in Christ, over supper in Ohrid. Pull up another chair—for the doubter, the difficult friend, the one who almost stayed away. Pass the bread far enough that everyone can reach.

items.role: Created and curated by Petre Laskov in collaboration with AI.
items.description: You have been fighting for so long. Sit here a while. Beneath the battered armour, something is still capable of being moved; the open hand is offered to that, and to all the rest of you.
introParagraphs: Give up the battle. There is no enemy here.

The armour, the defiance, the elaborate reasons why nothing matters: bring those too. Even the fiercest cynic may find, when the moment comes, that another person’s pain matters; that an offered hand reaches somewhere the argument never did.

These images dwell in that opening. Christ sits beside the one we were prepared to cast out. The distance between them begins to look less final. Make room for everyone. Keep going until there is no one left on the other side.

items.title: Light, dreams & other detours
items.summary: Compassion takes a face; a forest fills with impossible light. Some images give a shape to what we long for. Others lead us somewhere we would never have thought to ask to go.
items.alt: A luminous woman in white seated among lotus flowers by a lake at sunset.

images.title: Here, take my hand
images.alt: Tara beside a lake reaches towards the viewer, with mountains and sunset behind her.
images.description: The offered hand has become a touch. Tara draws close enough to meet us where we are, with all the unfinished business of being alive.

images.title: A little light
images.alt: A woman in white emerges through soft golden light, flowers and pale painterly colour.
images.description: For a moment, gentleness seems to have become visible. The edges dissolve; the light keeps arriving.

images.title: The whole world, for a moment
images.alt: A softly painted adult and child embrace amid warm pink, gold and violet brushwork.
images.description: Another person’s sorrow has its own weather, its own time. Here, someone has come close enough to share it. For this moment, there is nowhere else they need to be.

images.title: Deep in the glowing heart
images.alt: Golden sunbeams fall through a lush forest onto a bright carpet of flowers.
images.description: Where words fall silent.

images.title: What the hand can hold
images.alt: An enormous mechanical hand and weathered figure resting in water beside a ruined city.
images.description: A hand full of treasure; a hand opening into the water. The kingdom is coming apart around them. What can be received when the grip finally loosens?
images.inspiration: Inspired by the Zen saying: “Gain is delusion; loss is enlightenment.”

images.title: Endless robes
images.alt: Pale woodland spirits in moth-patterned robes stand among dark roots and branches; a central figure holds a small round mirror.
images.description: Their garments trail into roots, their hair into branches. Stay here long enough and the forest may forget where it ends and you begin.

items.role: Created and curated by Petre Laskov in collaboration with AI.
items.description: White Tara, her hand open above the water. A tenderness spacious enough for everything we arrive carrying. May we learn to offer some of it to one another.

items.title: Earlier wanderings
items.summary: Earlier excursions into the shared imagination. Tea pours itself, flowers grow beyond all proportion, and the forest has been expecting someone. There is a particular pleasure in following an image before you know why it matters.
items.alt: A flowing robed figure holds a teacup below a floating teapot, surrounded by luminous winged creatures in a lush forest.

images.title: Luminous
images.alt: A solitary seated figure glows warmly in a dark painterly space.
images.description: Someone sits in the dark, and a little of the dark becomes warm.

images.title: Holy Trinity, elsewhere
images.alt: Three veiled figures gather around a radiant fire in a dark sacred setting.
images.description: Three presences gathered around a fire, each looking into another world. The flame goes on offering the same place to meet.

images.title: Three around a flame
images.alt: Three veiled figures gather around a small fire; two look at glowing phones while the middle figure holds their head.
images.description: The Holy Trinity has connection problems. Three halos, two phones, a headset, and a small flame still burning between them. Somewhere inside all this distance is the possibility of looking up.

images.title: Take it easy, dude. But take it.
images.alt: A seated figure rests in a luminous forest clearing framed by towering trees.
images.credit: Take it easy dude, but take it, 2025 · Midjourney v7
images.description: Settle into the clearing. Let your shoulders drop. There are things worth giving your life to, and perhaps you can begin without making a fist.

images.title: The primacy of being
images.alt: A white-robed figure stands in a moonlit, mist-filled forest.
images.credit: The primacy of being, 2025 · Midjourney v7
images.description: Moonlight, moss, the patient company of trees. Before the next thing to become, this strange fact of already being here.

images.title: Strangefield
images.alt: A pastel surreal landscape of rolling fields beneath an expansive sky.
images.description: The hills have wandered into colours they cannot account for. A path continues between them. It seems worth seeing where it goes.

images.title: Bloom
images.alt: A kimono-clad figure stands among monumental red spider lilies.
images.description: The flowers have outgrown the person carrying them. She appears to have accepted the arrangement.

images.title: An evening elsewhere
images.alt: A figure in purple stands within a neon floral dreamscape.
images.description: Somewhere, evening arrives in violet. The flowers keep their own small lights, and someone has dressed for the occasion.

items.role: Created and curated by Petre Laskov in collaboration with AI.
items.description: The tea is pouring itself. The guests appear to be made of wings, leaves, and improbable intentions. Somehow, everyone seems to know how to behave.
